purpose: Internal feasibility sample for independent human review of public author-train /R/ clips
candidateRule: Exactly one canonical R in a pinned author-train utterance; aggregate equals the five-rater mean
selectionOrder: Within each stratum, sort by SHA-256 of seed:stratum:utterance-ID, then take the first ten whose speaker was not selected earlier
reviewerIdRule: First 16 hex characters of HMAC-SHA-256 with a locally generated 256-bit blinding key and message reviewer:utterance-ID; key remains only in ignored internal manifest
reviewerQueueOrder: Sort all 40 reviewer entries by HMAC-SHA-256 with the same private key and message queue:utterance-ID, independent of stratum order
